author: CityVision TV
title: Diaspora Talk with Dr. Bharat Raj Poudel
summary: Our talk show exploring the issues that shape life for Nepali people living abroad.
body:
Diaspora Talk, hosted by Dr. Bharat Raj Poudel, brings together voices from across the community to discuss the questions that matter to Nepali people living abroad.

Watch episodes on our YouTube channel and follow this page for new releases.

Have a topic you would like the show to cover? Let us know.
